biography.value:
Description

This ugly creature has a boar-like head with three eyes, the central eye twice the size of those flanking it, a thick bullish body with a stony hump upon its back, and cloven hooves on its stumpy legs. - Imban

Defense

AC 31, touch 7, flat-footed 30 (-1 Dex, +34 natural, -2 size)

hp 270 [360] (20d10+160)

Fort +20, Ref +13, Will +12

Immune freedom of movement; SR 26

Offense

Speed 50 ft., swim 30 ft.

Melee bite +28 (3d6+10/19-20), 2 hooves +26 (1d8+5)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.

Special Attacks Demon Eyes, Eruption, Magnitude 8, trample (4d6+15, DC 30), Wallop

Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th, Concentration +24)

3/day - Aeroga (DC 19)

Statistics

Str 30, Dex 8, Con 26, Int 5, Wis 19, Cha 10

Base Atk +20; CMB +32; CMD 40 (44 vs. trip)

Feats Cleave, Diehard, Endurance, Great Cleave, Improved Critical (Bite), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception)

Skills Perception +33, Swim +18; Racial Modifiers +8 Swim

Languages Aklo, Terran

Ecology

Environment hill regions

Organization solitary or pair

Treasure incidental

description.value: As a 1-round action, an orothkamila can call up an eruption of burning earth under the petrified statue of an enemy within 30 feet in order to shatter them, inflicting 100 fire damage and 100 earth damage. If the target of this attack is not suffering from the Statue status effect, they take no damage.

effect: Only damages a petrified statue; shatter it.

description.value: Once every 1d6+1 rounds, an orothkamila can cause the ground to erupt wildly around it within a 60-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 15d10 points of earth damage and are inflicted with the weighted status effect for 1d8 rounds. They must make a successful Reflex save (DC 24) to reduce the damage by half and negate the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31).
